# Example files (fictional)

> **DEMO FILES. All interviews, persons, companies and events are invented**
> for jellyqda's examples, tests and vignette. Any resemblance to real persons
> or organisations is coincidental. Every file starts with a line that marks
> it as a demo file.

| File | Content | Why it is here |
|---|---|---|
| `interview_01.txt` | career path of a project lead | plain UTF-8 text, paragraphs as segments |
| `interview_02.md` | team collaboration and trust | Markdown import |
| `interview_03.docx` | a typical working day | Word import |
| `interview_latin1.txt` | further training | **Latin-1 encoded on purpose**: tests the encoding detection |
| `fieldnotes.pdf` | field notes from a team meeting | PDF with a text layer |
| `broken_scan.pdf` | an empty "scanned" page | PDF **without** text layer: tests the import warning |

Use them with `system.file("extdata", "interview_01.txt", package = "jellyqda")`.
They are generated by `data-raw/make_extdata.R`.
